description: This file defines core rendering logic for a React-Three-Fiber integration, including root creation, rendering, unmounting, portal creation, and related utilities. It manages WebGLRenderer setup, scene and camera initialization, WebXR session handling, and rendering configuration.

classes.name: ReconcilerRoot
classes.description: Interface representing a React-Three-Fiber root with configuration, render, and unmount methods.

classes.name: Provider
classes.description: React component providing context and initializing the rendering environment.

classes.name: Portal
classes.description: Component for rendering React elements into a different scene container, supporting portals.

methods.name: computeInitialSize
methods.description: Calculates initial size and position of the canvas based on its parent or offscreen properties.

methods.name: createRoot
methods.description: Creates and configures a React-Three-Fiber rendering root for a given canvas, managing setup and rendering lifecycle.

methods.name: unmountComponentAtNode
methods.description: Unmounts and cleans up the React-Three-Fiber root associated with a given canvas.

methods.name: createPortal
methods.description: Creates a React portal into a specified THREE.Object3D container.

methods.name: flushSync
methods.description: Forces React to synchronously flush updates within a callback.
